title: SVAF Embeddings Schema
description: Schema for per-speaker voice embeddings (as built, format version 0.x). BIOMETRIC DATA: subject to the fail-closed rule of RFC-0001 section 11.3.

overlap_excluded.description: Whether overlapping speech was excluded when computing centroids

tracks.description: One entry per identity id (identities.json), e.g. p:spk_01

centroid.description: Mean embedding vector of length dim; null when no usable speech was available for this track

speech_sec.description: Total speech duration the centroid is based on

n_segments.description: Number of segments the centroid is based on
